name: 97. OpenRouter non-Claude models reject prompt_cache_breakpoint (PR #6692 regression)
description:
Regression coverage for the PR #6692 follow-up (https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/pull/6692#issuecomment-5711483907): Claude Code + OpenRouter + GPT models broke in v2.1.0.

Production path: /anthropic/v1/messages -> Bifrost Responses request -> OpenRouterProvider.Responses -> ToOpenAIResponsesRequest -> POST {OpenRouter}/v1/responses.

responsesUsesPromptCacheBreakpoints returned true for every OpenRouter model, so every cache_control marker became prompt_cache_breakpoint. OpenRouter converts that back into an Anthropic breakpoint for Claude (folder 69), but forwards it verbatim to OpenAI/Azure for GPT models, and pre-5.6 GPT upstreams reject it: 400 "prompt_cache_breakpoint is not supported on this model". Claude Code sends cache_control on nearly every request, so the route was unusable.

The gate is now the datasheet flag supports_prompt_cache_breakpoints, falling back to Claude or gpt-5.6 on OpenRouter when the row is silent.

What each case pins:
  97.1 the Claude Code route (/anthropic/v1/messages) with gpt-5.4: 2xx and no breakpoint on the wire.
  97.2 the native /v1/responses route with gpt-5.4: same invariant, independent of the Anthropic integration.
  97.3 the streaming handler with gpt-5.4: no upstream rejection in the SSE stream.
  97.4 control: gpt-5.6 on OpenRouter still receives breakpoints (the field is supported there), so the gate is not over-dropping.
  97.5/97.6 gpt-6-astra on /v1/responses and the Claude Code route. The name-based fallback does not match gpt-6, so the breakpoint only appears if the datasheet row sets supports_prompt_cache_breakpoints: true; a missing row degrades to a silent 2xx cache miss, which these cases catch.

Folder 13 covers OpenRouter cache_control on Chat Completions only, which never hits this translation.
